parameters.name: AssociationId
parameters.description: The associate ID between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and the VBR.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the network instance to query.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the network instance. Valid values: **VBR**: virtual border router instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: sends a check request without modifying service resources.
- **false** (default): sends a normal request.

parameters.name: EcrId
parameters.description:
The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID.
>You can call the DescribeExpressConnectRouter operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is required.
- If a subsequent query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.
